@sync_safety_context
def check(*, session: requests.Session, packages: List[Package]=[],
    db_mirror: Union[Optional[str], bool]=False, cached: int=0,
    ignore_vulns: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, ignore_severity_rules:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, proxy: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None,
    include_ignored: bool=False, is_env_scan: bool=True, telemetry: bool=
    True, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, project: Optional[str]=None
    ) ->tuple:
    
    SafetyContext().command = 'check'
    
    if not packages:
        packages = get_packages()
    
    if ignore_vulns is None:
        ignore_vulns = {}
        
    if ignore_severity_rules is None:
        ignore_severity_rules = {}
        
    db = fetch_database(session, full=False, db=db_mirror, cached=cached,
                       telemetry=telemetry)
    
    db_full = fetch_database(session, full=True, db=db_mirror, cached=cached,
                           telemetry=telemetry)
    
    vulnerabilities = []
    remediations = defaultdict(dict)
    found_packages = {}
    
    for pkg in packages:
        pkg_name = canonicalize_name(pkg.name)
        found_packages[pkg_name] = pkg
        
        if pkg_name not in db['vulnerable_packages']:
            continue
            
        for req in pkg.requirements:
            if not req.specifier:
                continue
                
            for spec in req.specifier:
                spec_str = str(spec)
                vulns = get_vulnerabilities(pkg_name, spec_str, db)
                
                for vuln_data in vulns:
                    vuln_id = str(next(filter(lambda i: i.get('type', None) == 'pyup', vuln_data.get('ids', []))).get('id', ''))
                    if not vuln_id:
                        continue
                        
                    cve = get_cve_from(vuln_data, db_full)
                    
                    ignore_vuln_if_needed(pkg, vuln_id, cve, ignore_vulns, ignore_severity_rules, req)
                    
                    vuln = get_vulnerability_from(
                        vuln_id=vuln_id,
                        cve=cve,
                        data=vuln_data,
                        specifier=spec_str,
                        db=db,
                        name=pkg_name,
                        pkg=pkg,
                        ignore_vulns=ignore_vulns,
                        affected=req
                    )
                    
                    if not vuln.ignored or include_ignored:
                        vulnerabilities.append(vuln)
    
    # Add local notifications for unpinned packages
    if is_env_scan:
        announcements = add_local_notifications(packages, ignore_unpinned_requirements=None)
        SafetyContext().local_announcements.extend(announcements)
    
    # Calculate remediations
    remediations = calculate_remediations(vulnerabilities, db_full)
    
    # Add announcements from server
    if is_env_scan:
        try:
            announcements = get_announcements(session, telemetry=telemetry)
            SafetyContext().server_announcements.extend(announcements)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    return vulnerabilities, remediations
